correctness.rationale: Strict origin containment iff all three cyclic gaps are positive and less than n/2, including the diameter-side exclusion at even orders. Counting these compositions gives exact conditioning denominators; each area equals R^2/2 times the sum of three arc sines. First and second moments reduce to H, U and C; their tabulated finite trigonometric sums follow from geometric series, including mixed sine sums. Algebraically simplifying reproduces the displayed conditional moments, and Taylor expansion yields the exact odd n^-2 and even n^-1 variance corrections. Standalone verify_center_triangles.py was executed from the packaged path: 595665 Cartesian triangle tests through n=62, 148800 positive membership tests, agreement in probabilities, means, second moments and independent arc sums, plus asymptotic spot checks. No numerical enumeration is used to infer an all-n theorem.

value.rationale: The center-containing triangle event is a fundamental and previously studied geometric probability model for random inscribed polygons; the conditional dispersion of triangle area is a natural unknown observable independent of the unconditional mean. Complete exact formulas at all orders make transparent a nontrivial parity effect: strict exclusion of diameter-side degeneracies is essential to the negative 3/(4n) leading even-order variance bias, while odd orders lack an O(1/n) correction. This is a meaningful exact classification/asymptotic mechanism rather than a renamed value or arbitrary enumeration.
